title: Protection Requirements, Bundled Discounts, Points Earn Rates and Corporate Eligibility by Product
content:
Four figures recorded against each of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products govern its relationship with the rest of the house: whether travel protection must be held for the package to be confirmed, the discount a protection premium bought with the package takes, the rate at which the package price accrues Wanderlane Traveller Club points, and whether the product may be booked under a corporate travel programme.

| Product | Travel protection must be held | Discount on a protection premium bought with the package | Club points earn rate, as a share of the package price | May be booked under a corporate travel programme |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | no | 5 per cent | 50 per cent | no |
| Flex Bundle Package | no | 8 per cent | 75 per cent | no |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | no | 10 per cent | 100 per cent | no |
| Escorted Tour Package | yes | 12 per cent | 100 per cent | no |
| Ocean Cruise Package | yes | 12 per cent | 125 per cent | no |
| Luxury Collection Package | yes | 20 per cent | 200 per cent | yes |

## The same figures put as three questions the schedule answers

**Which products require travel protection to be held?** The Escorted Tour Package, the Ocean Cruise Package and the Luxury Collection Package.

**What discount does a protection premium bought with an All-Inclusive Resort Package take?** 10 per cent, the figure recorded against that product.

**Which product may be booked under a corporate travel programme?** The Luxury Collection Package alone; every other product in the range records that it may not.
